# Timetime


## Birth and Early Life


> ~ 750 DR


Magnolie does not remember her Birth. The first thing she remembers is waking up in Lorwyn after the Faerie queen Oona caused the Great Aurora, turning the whole fae subrealm into from Shadowmoor into Lorwyn. Magnolie was then taken as an apprentice by Maralen, an avatar of Oona, and learned the basics of wizardry, as well as the appreciation of magical mischief and specatular spells from her. When some many years after a fae crossing opened in Lorwyn, connecting the realm to the Moonshae Isles of Faerun, Magnolie couldnt resist the urge to explore other realms, in the hopes of finding more exotic spells. As she left Lorwyn at that point, she is unaware of the current state of the plane, including the separation into Lorwyn and the Shadowmoor, and Maralens Rulership.


## Stay on the Moonshae Isles


> ~ 800 DR


After entering the Moonshae Isles on the Island of Alaron, she stayed there for ~50 years. She befriended a Human of the Ffolk named Shane O’Farrell, who worked the Mines in the north of the island. Here she got to know the Culture and Magic of the Isle, getting to know a range of druidic tricks, and the habits of the humans living there. Using her magic, she was able to help the islanders to a great amount. However, time was not as forgiving to her human friend as it was to her. His death was a shock to her, as she was blissfully unaware of, or at least aimed to push away, the limits of the human lifespan so far. This caused an immense frustration regarding the human, and to an extend of all the less long living race's lifespan in her. She decided to concern herself less with the lives of the short lived races, and instead focus more on her spells and herself. She then left the island, shortly getting to know the other two main isles of the moonshae, but they were too much like Lorwyn, she decided she would not learn much new here.


## Travels through Faerun


> ~ 860 DR


After leaving the Moonshae Isles, Magnolie travelled all across fearun for many centuries, with the goal of encountering many different civilisations and observe and learn parts of their magic. Hereby, Magnolie never cared much on what side of the moral spectrum the people around her were, as long as they wielded interesting magic. Thus, she would join groups of good, evil, and every tone of grey in between during her travels. Magnolie would leave places that did not satisfy her hunger for magic within days, but could stay at places feeding her hunger for knowledge for half a century, purely based on whim. But when she disappeared, it was usually unexpected to the ones around her, as she often left once people turned old or sick. She said it was not her fault that these species were so short lived, so she did not need to stick around for their demise. She always aimed to learn but not draw attention, so she was free to appear in a different place at any time without consequences from her prior actions. During her times, Magnolie experiences several world-shaking events, such as the *Times of Troubles*, the *Spellplague*, and the *Second Sundering*. The following lists the order of her tavels, with minor indicators of what she encountered:


- Chult (Mezro, Ancient Port Nyanzaru, Yuan-Ti)

- Lands of Intrigue (Short time with Pirates, Calimshan at Calimport observing elemental magic and djinn)

- Vilhon Reach (Chondath, Before the Druids Arrival, Telepathic Halflings)

- Old Empires (Short Stay, Too many Gods)

- Arcane Empires (Long Stay in Thay at the Red Wizards, Shorter one in Rashamen with Berserkers and Witches, Witnessed the founding of Aglarond)

- Heartlands (Longer stay at Zhentil Keep before it was destroyed, Short Stay at the Dalelands, Learning about Dragon History in Cormyr)

- Witnessing the second rise of netheril and the flying city of shade on the great desert of Anauroch (~1372 DR)

- Exporing the Underdark in the North (Lloth and Seldarine Drow, Duregar and Deep Dwarves, Some Rare Apparations)

- The North (Mirabar, Neverwinter)

- Sword Coast (Elturel, Baldurs Gate with Flaming Fists and the Guild, Waterdeep)


## Joining La Familia


> ~ 10-15 Years Ago (~1485 DR)


After having travelled all over Faerun for over 700 years, Magnolie was wondering if it was time to travel to *evermeet*, as many elves of the realm have told her they would do once there was nothing more to do for them. Rarely did she encounter elves who stayed for as long as she did, even in the livly cities of the sword coast. However, as she took time to reflect on her travels, she remembered why she took out on her travels in the first place. To find beauty in magic and spells. And while Magnolie had observed many Great Mages in Action, Many Magnificent Artifacts being Used, and Many Magic Monsters wrecking havock, she noticed that she herself did not really grow at all, over all these year. While she had taken bits and bites from the cultures she visited, that was it. She had never taken the effort to actually improve herself. Maybe it was because she thought she had the time, that she did not need to rush like the short lived ones around her did, but whatever the reason, she did not grow. So Magnolie decided, that her story was not over yet, indeed, instead of just observing the stories of others, she had to grow herself. With this newfound motivation, she visited a magic exhibition in ..., where great magical artifacts were displayed. One Artifact there especially caught her attention: A transmuters stone, created by an unknown archwizard, that was said to be able to manipulate the very being of creatures. Using her knowledge from her past adventures, she managed to sneak past the guards, into the room where the original stone was kept. However, when she approached, something unexpected happened. It reacted to her, discharging its magic, removing all mali as indifference, fear and detatchment that the old age had brought her, and also aging her body (although as an elf, she still did not look extraordinary old) by about 600 years. However, the magic alerted the guards, and Magnolie was horrified to loose her acquired motivation by being thrown into jail or worse. Luckily, she was not alone. A member of the local thieves guild, DER BOSS, was unknowingly also present in the room, with the task of stealing the stone. The guards and Magnolias presence could lead to him being found out, and he was not to return empty handed, so he grabbed Magnolia, as she had absorbed the stones magic, and managed to escape before the guards arrived


## Life with la Familia


> Then - Now


After being rescued by DER BOSS, Magnolie thought herself in grave dept to her rescuer. But she also saw an opportunity. In a city like this, close to the tradehotspots of faerun, powerfull mages, scrolls, and artifacts would not be far off. So she struck a deal with her rescuer, she would pay back the dept she had by helping out in the guild, and with her pay, she would aspire to heighten her skills as a wizard. However, now she had a new goal. If the magic of the stone was so powerful, that it could rejuvinate an elf such as her, then maybe the inferior short lived species did not need to stay inferior. If only she could replicate such powerful transmutation magic, she could eliminate the weaknesses of humans and also of herself. Until now, she has only managed to produce a weak copy of the stone she had found back then, but she is ready to do anything to become more powerful and achieve her goal.

# Character

## Personality. 
Caring about good or evil will only hinder me. I'll do what must be done to achieve my goals.

## Ideal. 
**Beauty through Magic.** In magic lies Beauty. I'll use it to bring beauty to myself and others.

## Bonds.
I have lived among many people whom I didn't say goodbye to. I would like to learn their fate, even If I say I don't care.

## Flaws.
I impose my own understanding of concepts on others, often disregarding their stance.
